opportunities.point: The company is actively planning to expand and invest in new or start-up businesses in limited liability partnership (LLP) firms within specialty chemicals.

opportunities.point: A requisite pilot plant facility for such products is likely to be established by the company at LLP firms in due course.

opportunities.point: Expectations baked into the price are low, so little has to go right.
P/E is cheaper than the sector median.

opportunities.point: The company is debt free and has no borrowings from any bank or institution.
opportunities.evidence: Capital allocation: "The company has no borrowings from any Bank or any Institution. There are no outstanding interest payments. Our company is debt free." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: Price volatilities continued during the year under review.

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
Peers earn a better ROCE - the competitive position looks weaker.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Disturbances from international events like Covid-19 and the Ukraine war affected the company and supply chains.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Disturbances due to International event like Covid-19, Ukraine war etc. are being faced by the company." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

threats.point: Prolonged ill effects and disturbances in the supply chain continued till the date of the report.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The prolonged ill effects including disturbances in the supply chain and such other disturbances continued till the date of this report." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

threats.point: Price volatilities continued during the year under review.
